map.把自增数字 ID 编码成短且不易猜的字符串（Hashids）: Encode auto-increment numeric IDs into short, hard-to-guess strings (Hashids)
map.支持设置盐值与最小长度，盐不同则编码结果完全不同: Supports setting a salt and a minimum length; a different salt gives a completely different encoding
map.可逆：同样盐值可把短串解回原数字: Reversible: with the same salt a short string can be decoded back to the original numbers
map.用于 URL 里隐藏业务量与防止遍历爬取: Used in URLs to hide business volume and prevent enumeration crawling
map.把数字 ID 编码成不易猜的短串（如 ?id=laHqu）。: Encode numeric IDs into short strings that are hard to guess (such as ?id=laHqu).
map.对外隐藏自增 ID：把数据库主键 123 编码成 xoz 之类的短串放在 URL: Hide auto-increment IDs externally: encode database primary key 123 into a short string like xoz for the URL, avoiding exposure of business volume and enumeration crawling.
map.填入盐值：这是保密项，泄露后短串可被反推: Enter the salt: this is the confidential item; if it leaks, short strings can be reversed
map.设置最小长度，控制短串的外观长度: Set a minimum length to control how long the short string looks
map.输入要编码的数字（可多个），点生成得到短串: Enter the numbers to encode (several are allowed) and click generate to get short strings
map.把短串放进 URL，如 ?id=xxxx: Put the short string in the URL, for example ?id=xxxx
map.解码时用同一盐值；盐值一旦更换，历史短串全部失效，需提前规划: Use the same salt when decoding; once the salt changes, all historical short strings become invalid, so plan ahead
map.若需要真正防遍历，应使用不可预测且服务端可校验的标识（如随机 UUID）配合授权: If you really need to prevent enumeration, use an unpredictable identifier that the server can verify (such as a random UUID) together with an authorization check - authorization is the real security boundary
map.可逆，是编码非加密；换 salt 结果不同。: Reversible, it is encoding not encryption; a different salt gives a different result.
map.Hashids 能当安全措施吗？: Can Hashids serve as a security measure?
map.不能。它只是可逆的混淆编码，拿到 salt 或足够多的样本就能反推，设计目标是「: No. It is only a reversible obfuscation code; with the salt or enough samples it can be reversed, and its design goal is 'make IDs look unattractive' rather than 'make IDs unguessable'. If you really need to prevent enumeration, use an unpredictable identifier that the server can verify (such as a random UUID) together with an authorization check - authorization is the real security boundary.
